limits: Full analytic Circle and Line host extraction only; trimmed Circle/other original families reject explicitly.
Requested samples only, no continuous/global deviation or whole-domain parameter-map certificate.
Runtime guard integers are process-local diagnostics, not globally unique/durable identity; fresh-process proof is tied to distinct launcher PIDs.
FCStd native ASCII changes tiny converted pole coordinates within measured1e-12mm bound; converted BRep raw bytes are not claimed exact.
Existing converter/native SDK and FFI are not a memory-safety, all-worker, thread or aggregate-allocation certificate.
